title: Ghostwriter background sync tasks can expire without completing the BGTask

evidence.quote: let syncTask = Task { ... task.setTaskCompleted(success: true) ... } ... task.expirationHandler = { syncTask.cancel() ... }
let syncTask = Task { ... task.setTaskCompleted(success: true) ... } ... task.expirationHandler = { syncTask.cancel() ... }
Set expirationHandler before starting work ... Ensure `setTaskCompleted` called exactly once

reasoning: The Ghostwriter BGAppRefresh handlers only call setTaskCompleted from the async success/failure path. On expiration they cancel the Swift task and log, but cancellation is cooperative; if syncFeeds or syncDigests does not throw before the system deadline, the BGTask is never completed. The local digest handlers already use TaskCompletionGuard to complete false from expiration, so this is an inconsistent lifecycle contract in the feature entrypoint.
reproduction: Run a Ghostwriter feed or digest sync that blocks or ignores Task cancellation, then simulate expiration for com.codable.epilogue.feedSync or com.codable.epilogue.digestSync. The expiration handler returns without calling setTaskCompleted(success: false).
recommendation: Apply the same TaskCompletionGuard pattern used by LocalDigestScheduler: create the guard before work starts, set expirationHandler before starting or immediately around the task launch, cancel the underlying task, and call complete(task, success: false) from expiration while the success/failure path also goes through the guard.
whyTestsDoNotAlreadyCoverThis: The linked tests cover LocalDigestScheduler date/digest coverage helpers and DigestGenerator filename uniqueness. They do not instantiate BGAppRefreshTask handlers or simulate expiration for GhostwriterBackgroundTaskManager.
suggestedRegressionTest: Add an injectable BG task wrapper or small task-completion abstraction for GhostwriterBackgroundTaskManager, then test that invoking the expiration handler completes exactly once with success false even when the coordinator never returns after cancellation.
minimumFixScope: GhostwriterBackgroundTasks.swift handler lifecycle only; no scheduler redesign required.
